title: Sample Film
logline: A red paper boat drifts down a rainy street gutter toward the sea.
_note: 这是一个最小可用的 manifest 模板。reference_image 换成你自己的参考图（放进 ComfyUI/input/）。prompt 里的 {BOAT} 会被 props 里的 BOAT 逐字展开，保证所有镜头用同一套措辞。expect 是 QA 正向锚点（3 个词），must_not 是负向门禁（命中即判失败）。

shots.shot: Low camera following the water surface
shots.audio: Rain on pavement, water rushing in the gutter
shots.prompt: <Picture 1> is the subject reference and drives its appearance only: {BOAT}. Ignore the reference background. A {BOAT} bobs and drifts down a rain-slick street gutter, streetlights reflecting in the ripples. Shot: low camera tracking the water surface, shallow depth of field, cool blue night light. Audio: rain on pavement and water rushing in the gutter.

props.BOAT: a small red folded paper boat

_qa_note: expect 只放 3 个场景锚点，避免假阴性；must_not 档住人、字幕、水印这类真实崩坏。
_prompt_convention: <Picture 1> 只给身份，场景由文字描述决定；{KEY} 占位符由 props 逐字展开。
